name: Keymapp Layers
author: ethan
description: Shows whether ZSA Keymapp is running and the active keyboard layer (with real layer names, read from Keymapp's local keymap cache), and lets you switch layers on the connected keyboard.

barWidget.description: ZSA Keymapp status, current layer, and layer switching via the Keymapp API (kontroll).

schema.label: Fallback layer count
schema.description: Layer names/count are normally read straight from Keymapp's local keymap cache. This is only used as a fallback if that can't be read (sqlite3 missing, cache not found, etc).

schema.label: Manual layer names (comma-separated, optional)
schema.description: e.g. "Base, Nav, Sym, Num". Overrides auto-detected names entirely when set. Leave blank to use the names from Keymapp (or plain numbers if those can't be read).
